items.title: 9 killed after a Learjet crashes and erupts into flames in Palm Beach County, Florida
items.brief: Nine people died after a Bahamas-bound Learjet crashed and then erupted in a fireball in Palm Beach County, Florida, Sunday afternoon, officials said.

items.title: 1 dead, 8 injured in pair of shootings after college football game in Alabama
items.brief: At least one person was killed and eight others injured in two nearby shootings, just minutes apart, after a college football game in Birmingham, Alabama, on Saturday, officials said.

items.title: Lions All-Pro LB Jack Campbell placed on backboard, carted off field after a tackle against Vikings
items.brief: Detroit Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter against the Minnesota Vikings.

items.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized with stroke and expected to make full recovery, his team says
items.brief: Democratic Sen. Chris Murphy has been hospitalized after experiencing a stroke and is expected to make a full recovery, his team announced Sunday.

items.title: 4 killed, about 15 injured after multiple overnight shootings in Dallas neighborhood, police say
items.brief: Four people were killed and approximately 15 others were injured after multiple overnight shootings in one of Dallas’ vibrant nightlife neighborhoods, police said.
